name: Report Registry
description: Durable, source-neutral report documents with immutable content receipts, explicit review attention, feedback routing receipts, and supersession.

modules.name: content
modules.description: Stable registration identity, immutable content receipts, provenance, and publication.

operations.name: REGISTER_REPORT
operations.description: Register one report idempotently with producer provenance and an immutable content receipt.
operations.template: Register a source-neutral report and freeze its initial content descriptor.

operations.name: PUBLISH_REPORT
operations.description: Move a draft report to final.
operations.schema: input PublishReportInput { expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

modules.name: attention
modules.description: Explicit operator attention, review receipts, and feedback routing truth.

operations.name: REQUEST_REVIEW
operations.description: Request one explicit operator review action for a final report.
operations.schema: input RequestReviewInput { request: ReportAttentionRequest! reasonCode: String reason: String reviewBy: DateTime expiresAt: DateTime expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: MARK_OPENED
operations.schema: input MarkOpenedInput { expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: MARK_READ
operations.description: Record a read receipt and resolve READ attention.
operations.schema: input MarkReadInput { expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: MARK_UNREAD
operations.description: Mark a final report unread without undoing other decisions.
operations.schema: input MarkUnreadInput { expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: ADD_FEEDBACK
operations.description: Attach operator feedback with an unrouted receipt.
operations.schema: input AddFeedbackInput { feedbackId: ID! bodyMarkdown: String! expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }
operations.template: Attach operator feedback without implying delivery.

operations.name: MARK_FEEDBACK_ROUTED
operations.description: Record successful delivery of feedback to a destination.
operations.schema: input MarkFeedbackRoutedInput { feedbackId: ID! destination: String! expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: MARK_FEEDBACK_ROUTE_FAILED
operations.description: Record a failed feedback delivery without claiming success.
operations.schema: input MarkFeedbackRouteFailedInput { feedbackId: ID! error: String! expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: DISMISS_ATTENTION
operations.schema: input DismissAttentionInput { expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: RESOLVE_ATTENTION
operations.description: Resolve an active answer, decide, approve, or request-change review.
operations.schema: input ResolveAttentionInput { expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }

operations.name: SUPERSEDE_REPORT
operations.description: Mark a final report superseded by another registered report reference.
operations.schema: input SupersedeReportInput { supersededByRef: String! expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }
operations.template: Supersede a report without deleting history.

operations.name: WITHDRAW_REPORT
operations.description: Withdraw a report without deleting history.
operations.schema: input WithdrawReportInput { reason: String expectedRevision: Int! occurredAt: DateTime! actorId: String! }
operations.template: Withdraw a report without deleting history.
